notes: Strip x3460-5220 plus ~300 px overlap. Price Hill inclined planes (vehicle/passenger) along y~5540-5590, railroads in State Avenue, the green/yellow/pink/grey subdivision and city-limit bands (incl. the E-W band at y~2525-2560 and 'CITY OF CINN' line) are not streets. A narrow unnamed strip (two lines y~3518/3543) runs east from Glenway at x~4955 - not recorded. Lines drawn inside many streets are water pipes/sewers, not curbs; centres taken between lot lines. Glenway's band is ~85 ft wide near Sterrett (x3400-3700) where lots on the SW side front a grey subdivision band. Underwood Place (x~3040) and Summit Avenue (x~3100) lie outside the overlap and were not picked. Names checked on the plate: Glenway, Claypool, Wing, Sterrett, Lehman Road (LEHMAN printed further west), Maryland, Warsaw, Morrow, Mt. Hope Road, Matson Pl., Price, W. Eighth, Stoddard Pl., Kingston Pl., Rudolph, Denver, Wilder, Gest ('GEST'), Nevada St., State, Mistletoe ('MISTLETOE', suffix from neighbouring pick). The street SE from Park 35 is printed only 'PLACE' and is recorded as '?'.
